title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1970-09-20
source: This is a restored version of shind: 97364; MR > R (Buddy Miller) HEAVILY EDITED > R @ 71/2ips (Will Boswell) > CD; Transfer info: reel > AKAI GX625 > Apogee Mini Me (24/96) > Apogee Mini Dac (monitoring) > Wavelab 5.0 (dithered to 16/44) > CD > EAC > Wav > Flac16Restoration completed with Diamond Cut Forensics 10.2.

ai_review.summary: A stellar acoustic performance captured on an audience‑stealth rig – overall clear and enjoyable despite some instrument‑balance quirks.
ai_review.review: Reviewers rave about the acoustic set, highlighting Phil Lesh’s solid bass work and the added mandolin texture from David Grisman and David Nelson. The recording is generally good, with only minor audio imperfections; one version even fixes a warbled middle section of “Caution,” though it slightly mutes Pigpen’s harp and vocal mic while boosting organ. Overall the show is praised far more than the technical hiccups.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers give 5‑star ratings and praise the performance; a few note recording quirks, leading to an overall high but slightly moderated score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Minor audio imperfections noted; stealth rig under stage provides decent clarity. One version improves a warped middle section of “Caution” but reduces Pigpen’s harp/vocal mic while boosting organ levels.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Acoustic half‑set shines with guest mandolin work, creating a richer texture than comparable acoustic shows from the era.

band_member_comments.Phil: Phil Lesh’s bass playing is specifically praised on this acoustic night.
band_member_comments.Keys: Organ appears louder in this version; Pigpen’s harp and vocal mic are noticeably reduced.
